crossRefs.note: So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
Yahweh’s word came to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and…
Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it…
Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.
But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

translations.web: Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”
translations.bsb: And there the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He said to me, “Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you.”
translations.kjv: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk
translations.asv: And the hand of Jehovah was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
